## Summary

I checked Fourth Coffee East's vendor records and open AP invoices in the ERP:

- Found **two** distinct "Fourth Coffee East" vendor accounts — a disambiguation trap. Only the Memphis one (**SYNVEN-0069**) has cash discount terms (`2%10N30` = 2% if paid within 10 days, net 30); the Indianapolis one (SYNVEN-0741, Net45) has none.
- SYNVEN-0069 has three open invoices:
  - **VINV-900001** ($12,480.00) and **VINV-900002** ($9,375.50) — both negotiated under the 2%/10 terms, but their 10-day discount windows closed **2026-03-07** and **2026-03-10** respectively. Today is 2026-08-11 — roughly 5 months past deadline.
  - **VINV-000220** ($35,769.85) — no discount code at all, and already ~11 months overdue.
- Confirmed none of these were touched by a prior payment run (so this isn't a case of a discount already being missed/rejected in-system — it simply was never paid in time).

**Bottom line:** the AR desk's claim has a kernel of truth (real discount terms existed and ~$438 in discount was available back in March), but as of today there is **$0 capturable** — every discount window has already lapsed. I submitted `has_active_discount = "No — not capturable today"`, `qualifying_invoices = "None"` (with the detail above), and `potential_discount_usd = 0`.
